"""Migration 001: create the clean ROM V2 baseline schema."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Migration:
    """Describe one immutable ordered SQLite migration."""

    version: int
    key: str
    sql: str

    @property
    def checksum(self) -> str:
        """Return the stable SHA-256 checksum of the migration SQL."""
        return hashlib.sha256(self.sql.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

"""Migration 002: add V1 attribute-point invariant support."""
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib
from rom_v2.infrastructure.persistence.migrations.v001_v2_baseline import Migration
MIGRATION_SQL=r"""ALTER TABLE character_primary_stats ADD COLUMN total_points_earned INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(total_points_earned>=0);
CREATE TRIGGER character_primary_stats_invariant_insert BEFORE INSERT ON character_primary_stats WHEN NEW.total_points_earned != NEW.unspent_points+NEW.strength+NEW.dexterity+NEW.intelligence+NEW.wisdom+NEW.stamina BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'attribute_point_invariant'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER character_primary_stats_invariant_update BEFORE UPDATE ON character_primary_stats WHEN NEW.total_points_earned != NEW.unspent_points+NEW.strength+NEW.dexterity+NEW.intelligence+NEW.wisdom+NEW.stamina BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'attribute_point_invariant'); END;"""
MIGRATION=Migration(version=2,key="primary_stats_parity",sql=MIGRATION_SQL)

from rom_v2.infrastructure.persistence.migrations.v001_v2_baseline import Migration

MIGRATION_SQL=r"""
CREATE TABLE item_definitions (
 item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(item_id>0),

) STRICT;
CREATE TABLE inventory_items (
 inventory_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(inventory_id>0),
 owner_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(owner_user_id>0),

) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX ix_inventory_items_owner ON inventory_items(owner_user_id,inventory_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_inventory_items_definition ON inventory_items(item_id,inventory_id);
"""
MIGRATION=Migration(version=3,key="item_identity_parity",sql=MIGRATION_SQL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS location_travels (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        from_node TEXT NOT NULL,
        to_node TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'
            CHECK(status IN ('active','arrived','cancelled','failed')),
        revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision >= 1),
        started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        arrival_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        cancelled_at TEXT,
        completed_at TEXT,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        CHECK(from_node <> to_node),
        FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    );
    CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_location_travels_one_active_user
        ON location_travels(user_id) WHERE status='active';
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_location_travels_due
        ON location_travels(status, arrival_at, id);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_location_travels_user_history
